Instructions for sending BSC tokens

Our Token-BulkSender.net facilitates effortless and lightning-fast transfers to thousands of wallets simultaneously. With just a few clicks, effortlessly manage a multitude of transactions, saving time and maximizing efficiency. Send tokens to a variety of wallets – quickly, securely, and stress-free.

Step 1

  • Connect to your Metamask wallet using the correct chain associated with the token you want to send. If you are on the wrong page, you will be notified to use the correct tool related to the suitable chain.
  • Wait for token balances to load, if failed to load the tokens, you can manually insert your token address
  • Select the token that you would like to send from the list

Step 2

  • Upload Excel, CSV, Txt addresses with amounts or manually insert addresses separated by comma
  • Make sure the tokens your sending belong to you!
  • Confirm amount to be sent

Step 3

  • Send Approve transaction
  • Confirm bulksending data, include txs, fees
  • Confirm transaction in your wallet
  • Token-BulkSender.net send tokens

Frequently asked

What is Token-BulkSender.net?

The dApp allows users to efficiently send thousands of tokens to multiple addresses through centralized transfers and automated processes. With this tool, users can save time by automatically generating transactions using MetaMask or other smart wallet software. Token-BulkSender.net is also completely secure in terms of account security, as private keys and other sensitive data are managed by the user’s wallet software.

How much time does multisending take?

It depends on the gas price and network congestion. It typically takes 3 to 5 minutes.

Is it a safe tool from Token-BulkSender?

Yes, the Token-BulkSender.net tool has been running since 2020 and is responsible for over 20,000 transactions on the mainnet, representing billions of dollars. The Multi-Sender Smart Contract and all previous transactions can be found on Etherscan, older versions can be viewed here.

Which wallets can I use?

You can use Metamask, a hardware wallet or any wallet supported by WalletConnect.
